Luxury & Boutique Hotels in Koh Phi Phi, Thailand | Small Luxury Hotels of the World

Introducing Koh Phi Phi

Some say these are the most beautiful islands in the world. The beaches are second to none, and the watersports are first class. The archipelago of islands that make up Koh Phi Phi is part of a marine national park, so as you’d expect the sea life is glorious. Be sure to get up close to it with a snorkel or a private diving excursion.  


Things to do

LANDMARKS
The viewpoint on Phi Phi Don gives you a spectacular bird’s eye view of the whole of Koh Phi Phi. You’ll find a shop at the top selling snacks too. While you’re on the island, the Tsunami Memorial Garden is a moving and tranquil place to visit.

WATER
Wherever you dive you’ll find coral reef teeming with multi-coloured fish, as well as playful turtles. There are underwater caves, canyons and spectacular limestone pinnacles to explore. You’ll find all the equipment and advice you need at the many diving shops on the islands.

SPA
If you’ve come here to relax, why not make sure your whole body gets the full treatment? There are lots of spas on the islands, and you can choose anything from a full body massage to a pedicure, with a backdrop of paradise all around you. Book a traditional Thai massage at your luxury beach resort and unwind to the sounds of the sea.  


Top Tip from SLH

You’ll probably see people cliff jumping while you’re here, and you can find organised cliff jumping tours on the islands. It’s best to take things easy to begin with – just jump in feet first.

Find out more about Phi Phi Islands


Phi Phi Islandsand its attractions for luxury travelers

The Phi Phi Islands offer a luxurious escape for travelers seeking both adventure and relaxation. Explore the stunning Maya Bay, known for its crystal-clear waters and dramatic cliffs, perfect for a private boat tour or a secluded picnic on the beach. For those who enjoy snorkeling, the vibrant marine life at Hin Klang provides an unforgettable underwater experience, with colorful corals and tropical fish. Indulge in a sunset dinner at the elevated viewpoint of Phi Phi Don, where the panoramic vistas will take your breath away as the sun dips below the horizon. You can also embark on a guided hike to the viewpoint, which offers an exhilarating trek with rewarding views for those who seek a little adventure. Stay at luxurious resorts like the Zeavola Resort, where you can unwind in spacious villas surrounded by pristine nature, or the luxurious Phi Phi Island Village Beach Resort, known for its stunning beachfront and exceptional service. Here, attentive staff ensure every moment is catered to, allowing you to savor the tranquility of your surroundings while enjoying high-end amenities.

Scored out of 10, guest rating 10

From the moment you land on the island you are shown such...

From the moment you land on the island you are shown such complete care and attention from the staff you feel instantly at home. The food, the drinks, the nightly entertainment by the crabs on the beach, the tropical fish you can snorkel with on a longboat tour with the staff; make it impossible to pick a favourite activity. Though to be honest for me it was definitely a tie between the beachside room & the snorkel trip around the cave. My partner would say the Amazing staff and meeting real life monkeys, but there was so much more than that it’s actually impossible to choose!!!! The whole staff on the island really gave this trip a special edge. Genuine care and thought went into every effort they made for us, by far our most favourite destination of the entire trip! One hot tip is that the resort is accessible by 20min boat trip and they have multiple available daily, but to make the absolute most of your island time -make sure you bring what you need with you to limit trips back into town (the town is well equipped so if you do need something you’ll be able to find it there!)

Guest review byElyce

Australia

Scored out of 10, guest rating 10

Phi Phi Island completely stole my heart.

Phi Phi Island completely stole my heart. It's a small and beautiful island, and from the moment I arrived, it felt like I belonged there. We spent four days on the island, and every day and night revealed a new side to explore. Whether it was wandering through the lively streets, discovering hidden corners, or simply soaking in the scenery, there was always something magical waiting around the next turn. At times, it felt as though I was walking through a movie scene created just for me. The natural beauty of the island is breathtaking. We spent hours at the beach enjoying the crystal-clear water, which was so transparent that we could see everything beneath the surface. The beaches were clean and surrounded by stunning shades of blue, turquoise, and emerald green that seemed almost unreal. Phi Phi is more than just a destination; it's a feeling. The island has a special charm that stays with you long after you've left. I arrived as a visitor but left feeling connected to a place that felt like home.

Guest review byAnuvea

India

It's a party island. Super fun if you are into that. Great fire shows on the beach. Full of massage and tattoo shops - like way too many. I stayed for 3 nights, I don't need to go back, much nicer places I'd rather be in Thailand. Make the hike up to the Viewpoint for sunset - super worth it. Super easy to walk to where ever you want to go.

Phi Phi Island is must visit Island.

Phi Phi Island is must visit Island. I stayed here for 2nights. We enjoyed night parties at Loh Dalam with fire shows. Visit Phi Phi View Point (with small hike about 40mins) for best sunset view There are no vehicles on this island, but you can walk on all the points on this island. Get a Longtail half day boat tour to see Maya Bay and other islands with snorkelling included (You may ignore Maya Bay visit as it's not that worth as you need to pay extra 400 baht for this beach visit) Overall very unique island, and must visit!
